# SODA lock file: every package with one exact version. install.ps1 / install.sh use this.
#
# Do not edit by hand. The human-edited lists are requirements.txt (core) and
# requirements-clustering.txt (whole-section UMAP and Leiden clusters); this file pins both
# and everything they pull in. To refresh it after changing them:
#   1. make a new, empty venv with Python 3.12 or 3.13
#   2. pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-clustering.txt
#   3. pip freeze, and copy the versions here (keep the platform markers below)
#   4. run tests/smoke_test.py with that venv, and let the CI run it on Linux
#
# Generated 2026-11-16 from pip freeze of a clean Python 3.13.9 venv on Windows 11 x64.
# Tested end to end (tests/smoke_test.py) on Windows x64 with Python 3.13 only.
# Cross-platform: checked with a resolver (uv pip compile --only-binary :all:) that every
# version below has a ready-made wheel for Python 3.12 and 3.13 on Windows x64, Linux x86_64
# (glibc 2.28 or newer: Ubuntu 20.04, RHEL 8 and later) and macOS 12 or newer on Apple
# Silicon (arm64), and that nothing outside this list gets pulled in. The CI installs it on
# Linux, Python 3.12, and runs the smoke test. Not run on a Mac by us.
# Not covered: Python 3.11 or older (imagecodecs, numpy, scipy here need 3.12+), Python 3.14
# (no numcodecs 0.15 wheels), Intel Macs (no cryptography / llvmlite wheels), Linux on ARM
# (no numcodecs wheels). Use the manual install in the README there.
#
# Platform-only packages: colorama is Windows-only (tqdm).
# 20 November 2026 (0.10.0): fastapi, uvicorn and the 17 packages only they pulled in were taken
# out with the live tile server (server.py); nothing else changed, so the tested set is the same.
